title: ICSI Releases Executive & Professional Study Material for December 2026 Exams
content:
# ICSI Releases Executive & Professional Study Material for December 2026 Exams

Ek important update hai for all CS Executive aur Professional Programme students! The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) ne December 2026 exams ke liye Executive aur Professional Programmes ka study material release kar diya hai. Yeh announcement July 28, 2026, ko kiya gaya hai.

Here are the key details:

*   **What's New:** ICSI has released the official study material applicable for the upcoming December 2026 examinations for both Executive and Professional Programmes.
*   **For Whom:** This update is crucial for all students preparing for their CS Executive and Professional Programme exams in December 2026.
*   **Key Updates:** The study materials include updated content, with various papers updated till specific dates in May, June, and November 2025 or May 2026, depending on the subject.
*   **Important Note:** Students are also advised to refer to the applicable supplements available along with the study materials on the ICSI academic portal for comprehensive preparation.

## Read the Official Document
*   [Download the Official Notification/Circular here](https://www.icsi.edu/media/webmodules/STUDY_MATERIAL_APPLICABLE_FOR_DECEMBER_2026_EXAMINATION.pdf)

*Published on: 29 July 2026*
